QF.id: XIII Introduction to Forwards and Futures_59

question.text: What is the position limit for a domestic client in USDINR futures across exchanges?

answer.text: Higher of 6% of total open interest or USD 20 million, with a separate USD 100 million single limit across INR currency pairs combined across exchanges where applicable
A fixed USD 20 million across all exchanges with no open-interest formulation
There is no position limit for USDINR futures

explanation.text: The Logic: Series I (pp.162-165) states that for domestic clients in USDINR, the gross open position across all contracts is the higher of 6% of total open interest or USD 20 million. The workbook also sets a separate USD 100 million single limit across INR currency pairs combined across exchanges where applicable. The Trap: A flat "USD 20 million across all exchanges" understates the rule because it omits the 6%-of-OI alternative and the USD 100 million combined-INR-pairs cap. Position limits absolutely exist for currency derivatives. Note: Source-backed by Series I Currency Derivatives workbook, pages 162-165.
